dgp: A=2+sin(.71*i)+.2*cos(.13*i); B=.7*e; Y=5+2*A-.2*B+.3*e; V=1+.25*A+.3*B+.3*e; i=0..799; e=sum of 12 uniforms minus 6 from one 64-bit LCG stream (B over all rows, then Y, then V)

oracle.method: linear law in `dgp`: every identified atom of the posterior has the structural derivative equal to the coefficient 2 (elasticity and semi-elasticities at A = 2, B = 0), so the posterior-weighted mean over the atoms that identify it is that value whatever the weights; the identified and unidentified masses are the sums of the atoms' weights
asserted_outputs: point, elasticity, semi_treatment, semi_outcome, average, jacobian, directional (posterior-weighted mixture), identified_mass, unidentified_mass, the planted off-support point
context_only_outputs: jacobian and directional (carried for the reference; the refuter states assert the scalar coordinates)
fixture_id and dgp text (checked only as a guard on the model used)
oracle.independence_basis: The generator differentiates the stated linear law by its coefficients in exact rational arithmetic, regenerates the stated noise stream from its integer recurrence, and solves the exact rational normal equations on the regenerated rows; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated law, the noise recurrence and the evaluation points.
oracle.historical_exposure: Written for this fixture from the stated law and declared inputs; no product implementation source was consulted and no earlier pinned numbers are reused.

reference_review.scope: Posterior-weighted mixtures of identical exact atom derivatives, the identified and unidentified posterior masses, and the position of a planted evaluation point relative to the observed treatment range.

reference_review.redistribution: Repository-authored MIT OR Apache-2.0 generator and deterministic inputs. Python standard library only, in an isolated locked script environment, outside the product and ordinary CI; no upstream source is stored.
reference_review.limitations: Every identified atom has the same structural derivative, so the fixture checks the mass bookkeeping and the mixture of equal atom values, not a mixture of different atom values. The law is linear, so the fixture cannot detect curvature errors. An atom whose graph has no directed path from the treatment to the outcome is not answered with a structural zero by the static derivative route and is not covered. The tolerances are declared estimation bands. No uncertainty or calibration.
